Bash(node -e "const q=require\('./src/data/questions.json'\); const types=[...new Set\(q.map\(x=>x.type\)\)]; const domains=[...new Set\(q.map\(x=>x.domain\)\)]; console.log\('Total questions:',q.length\); console.log\('Types:',types\); console.log\('Domains:',domains\); const diff={}; q.forEach\(x=>{diff[x.difficulty]=\(diff[x.difficulty]||0\)+1}\); console.log\('Difficulty:',diff\);")
